summary: Veterinarian onboarding and claims on the Phase 1 vet_profile row. Migration 0021 adds the REVIEW_OPERATOR role and context, the VET_APPLICATION_DOCUMENT file purpose, vet_application and vet_application_document, makes vet_profile.account_id and council_code nullable for unowned profiles and adds listed city/contact/source, claimed_at and hidden_by_review. A signed-in account applies from /account/vet-profile for a profile of its own, or claims an unowned profile from /account/vet-profile/claim/[slug], with a normalised council code and 1-5 private documents (council card required, JPG/PNG/PDF up to 10MB, signature-checked, readable only by the applicant, the review operator and the superadmin). One open application per account and one open claim per profile are enforced by partial unique indexes; a code another profile holds is refused and, when that profile is unowned, the message sends the applicant to claim it instead. The review operator works /review/vets: approve, request a correction or reject, always with a reason, a version check and an audit entry, never on their own application, with the duplicate candidates and documents on the decision page; the applicant is notified, answers a correction on the same case, appeals a rejection once, or withdraws it to the archive. Approving a PROFILE creates a draft directory profile with council_verified_at and no TRUSTED_VET role (DEC-0145); approving a CLAIM transfers the same row and address only while it is still unowned, keeping its history. The owner then manages that profile: content, consent, its own locations (licence NONE and no capability, so never in the Finder) and publication — but cannot republish a page the review hid. Only a claimed profile may buy an advertising package.

limitations: The suggestion form for ordinary users (§10) was not built: unowned profiles are published by the review operator from a recorded source, and the user-facing suggestion with its dedup arrives with the centre suggestion of PROMPT-009 (DEC-0166).
Reporting a veterinarian profile (§13) and merging duplicate profiles (§21) were not built; they belong to the admin operations of PROMPT-016.
Advertising packages do not exist yet: PROMPT-011 must call packagePurchaseEligibility before any payment, which today only refuses unowned profiles.
A second claimant sees «در حال بررسی» until the first claim is decided; competing claims are not queued.
An owner whose city is not in the seeded list cannot make a location public until the review operator or superadmin adds that city; the map and local pages belong to PROMPT-015.
The applicant's identity is taken from the Phase 1 account profile; no separate identity check is added here, and KYC stays a Phase 1 flow.

Browser and unit/DB checks were targeted by user instruction; unaffected suites were last run in full at commit 7c74577. tests/browser/pregnancy.test.ts was not re-run: the only Phase 1 change there is a type guard on a council code that an owned profile always has.
Visual fidelity of the onboarding, review and claim pages is UNVERIFIED: no Phase 2 Figma frame is in the sources.
